title: 고등교육기관의 자체평가에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Conduct of Self-Evaluation)
(1) The head of a school shall conduct a self-evaluation, in accordance with school regulations, of the information to be disclosed under Article 6 (1) of the Special Act on Disclosure of Information by Education-Related Institutions and of other matters that the head deems necessary to evaluate the school's education and research, etc., in order to improve the school's educational conditions and enhance the quality of education and research, etc.
(2) A self-evaluation under paragraph (1) shall be conducted at least once every two years. Provided, however, that where an accredited institution under Article 11-2 (2) of the Higher Education Act has comprehensively evaluated the overall operation of the school, such evaluation may substitute for the school's self-evaluation for the relevant year.
(3) Matters necessary for the standards, procedures, methods, etc. of self-evaluation shall be prescribed by the regulations of the relevant school.
